title: Understand verification trust
statement: As a developer reviewing quality proof, I can tell whether a result was execution-backed and produced against the current source so I do not mistake a caller assertion for verified execution.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Quality output distinguishes caller-supplied results from results captured by an execution mechanism and exposes which origin the active policy accepts.
When current-source proof is required, a run whose recorded commit differs from the observed source HEAD is reported stale and cannot satisfy quality.
